# Broadcasts in the app

The person does these in the Whatsable app. Give the path and the steps; never say you did it. Fetch the "Full steps" address for the exact steps, or give the person the link.

## Upload a CSV of recipients

- **What it is:** Upload a CSV of recipients and their template values, and match its columns.
- **Plan:** Bulk Message, Work, Growth, Pro, Agency and the 14-day trial.
- **Who can do it:** Owners, admins and members. A member limited to numbers cannot upload.
- **Where:** Broadcasts > New broadcast > Recipients and variables
- **The agent can:** pass the recipients and their variables to `create_broadcast` yourself, with no file (Full access)
- **Full steps:** https://docs.whatsable.app/features/broadcasts.md, section "step-two-compose-schedule-and-launch". For the person: https://docs.whatsable.app/features/broadcasts#step-two-compose-schedule-and-launch
